CONTENT RETAINER AGREEMENT

This Agreement is made on 24 February 2026 between Thornbury Analytics Limited, a company registered in Ireland, whose registered office is at 4 Sandwith Place, Dublin 2, D02 XH67 (the "Client"), and Ines Baptista, trading as Baptista Words, of 19 Ashfield Row, Galway, H91 TK33 (the "Contractor").

The parties agree as follows.

1. THE ENGAGEMENT

1.1 The Contractor shall write and edit the articles, briefing notes and release copy listed in Schedule 1 (the "Services").
1.2 The Contractor shall provide the Services on a continuing monthly basis rather than as a fixed project.
1.3 The Contractor shall perform the Services with reasonable skill and care.

2. HOW THE WORK IS DELIVERED

2.1 The Contractor shall deliver each item of the Services by the date agreed with the Client at the start of the month in which it falls.
2.2 The Contractor shall deliver each article as an editable document together with the supporting notes used to write it.
2.3 The Contractor shall carry out two rounds of revisions to each item at no additional charge.

3. TERM AND RENEWAL

3.1 This Agreement renews for a further term of one (1) month at the end of each term unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least fourteen (14) days before the end of the then-current term, and either party may end a renewed term on thirty (30) days' written notice.
3.2 The first term begins on 2 March 2026 and runs for twelve (12) months.

4. FEES, ACCEPTANCE AND PAYMENT

4.1 The Client shall pay the Contractor a retainer of €2,400 a month for the Services, invoiced on the last working day of each month.
4.2 The Client shall notify the Contractor in writing within five (5) working days of delivery whether an item meets the acceptance criteria in Schedule 2, identifying by reference to those criteria anything that does not.
4.3 An item is treated as accepted if the Client gives no notice under clause 4.2 within that period.
4.4 The Client shall pay each invoice within thirty (30) days of the date of the invoice.

5. CHANGES

5.1 A change to the monthly fee, to the Services or to any other term of this Agreement takes effect only once both parties have signed a written variation recording it, and either party may decline a variation and let this Agreement run to the end of its current term.
5.2 The Contractor may propose a change at any time, and the Client is under no obligation to accept it.

6. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY

6.1 On payment in full for an item of the Services, the Contractor assigns to the Client all intellectual property rights in that item.
6.2 The assignment in clause 6.1 covers the items delivered under this Agreement and nothing else, and it does not reach the Contractor's own research notes, templates or house style, which remain the Contractor's property.
6.3 The Contractor shall sign any document the Client reasonably requires in order to record the rights assigned under this clause 6.

7. CONFIDENTIALITY

7.1 Each party shall keep confidential the other party's commercial and technical information disclosed to it under this Agreement, and shall use that information only for the purposes of this Agreement.
7.2 Clause 7.1 does not apply to information that is already public or that a party is required by law to disclose.

8. STATUS OF THE CONTRACTOR

8.1 The Contractor is an independent contractor and nothing in this Agreement makes the Contractor an employee, agent or partner of the Client.
8.2 The Contractor decides how and when to carry out the Services, subject only to the delivery dates agreed under clause 2.1.

9. INDEMNITY AND LIABILITY

9.1 Each party shall indemnify the other against a claim brought by a third party to the extent that the claim arises from that party's own breach of this Agreement or its own negligence, and each indemnity is subject to the limit of liability in clause 9.2.
9.2 The total liability of each party under this Agreement is limited to the total fees payable in the twelve (12) months before the claim arose, and that limit applies to the Client and to the Contractor alike.
9.3 Nothing in this Agreement limits either party's liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, or for fraud.

10. ENDING THIS AGREEMENT

10.1 Either party may end this Agreement at the end of a term by giving notice under clause 3.1.
10.2 Where the Client ends this Agreement before the end of a term, the Client shall pay for every item accepted or delivered before the end date, for work in progress on the date of the notice, and one further month of the retainer.
10.3 Clauses 6, 7 and 9 survive the end of this Agreement.

11. AFTER THIS ENDS

11.1 Neither party restricts the other from working with any client, customer or supplier after the end of this Agreement.

12. NOTICES

12.1 A notice under this Agreement must be in writing and sent to the address shown at the head of this Agreement or to an email address the receiving party has given for the purpose.

13. GOVERNING LAW

13.1 This Agreement and any dispute arising out of or in connection with it are governed by the laws of Ireland, and the parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Irish courts.

14. WHOLE AGREEMENT

14.1 This Agreement is the whole agreement between the parties about the Services and replaces any earlier proposal, quotation or discussion.

SCHEDULE 1 — THE SERVICES

Item 1: Two long-form articles a month, each between 1,200 and 1,800 words.
Item 2: One briefing note a month for the sales team.
Item 3: Release copy for each product update, on request.
Item 4: A monthly editorial plan for the following month.

SCHEDULE 2 — ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA

An item meets the acceptance criteria when all four of the following are true.
Criterion 1: The item is within the word range set for it in Schedule 1.
Criterion 2: Every factual claim carries a source the Client can check.
Criterion 3: The item follows the Client's published style guide.
Criterion 4: The item is delivered in the agreed file format.

Signed for and on behalf of Thornbury Analytics Limited.

Signed by Ines Baptista, trading as Baptista Words.
